window.description: Completion window for every row in the batch (`"15m"`, `"1h"`, or `"24h"`).

requests.description: One or more inference rows sharing the same `body.model`. Each `body` is normalized to chat-completions shape at create (Responses `input` → `messages`), validated, then enqueued. Invalid rows return HTTP 400 with `requests[i]` and optional `custom_id`.

results.description: Per-request outcomes when batch is completed or failed.

message.default: If that email exists, a reset link was sent.

body.description: OpenAI-style request body. Must include `model`. Accepts chat completions shape (`messages`) or Responses shape (`input`); Responses fields are normalized to chat format at create, then validated before enqueue.

input.description: Input for the completion. Either a plain string (shorthand for a single user message) or an array of OpenAI Responses input items. Supported items: `message` (role + string/`input_text`/`output_text` content), `function_call`, and `function_call_output`. Other echoed output items (e.g. `reasoning`) are accepted and ignored. Items are normalized to chat messages server-side.

tools.description: Tool definitions. Accepts flat Responses API shape (`{type, name, description, parameters}`) or wrapped chat shape (`{type, function}`).

include_reasoning.description: If true, extracted reasoning is returned as a `reasoning` item in `output[]`. Set false to suppress reasoning while keeping the final text.

enable_thinking.description: When set, forwarded to the tokenizer `apply_chat_template(..., enable_thinking=...)`. Standard Qwen3 chat templates use this for thinking/reasoning mode (see SGLang reasoning-parser docs). Omit to use the tokenizer default.

background.description: If true, return immediately with status=in_progress and let the caller poll (async; does not require realtime_enabled). If false (default), block until completion or the server sync-timeout ceiling (sync/realtime; requires realtime_enabled).

stream.description: If true, stream the sync result as OpenAI Responses API server-sent events (`response.created`, `response.output_text.delta`, `response.completed`, ...). Only valid when `background` is false.

ResponseMetadata.title: ResponseMetadata
ResponseMetadata.description: Extra metadata including "completion_window" ("15m", "1h", or "24h") and optional "stream_id" for grouping.
